description: This file contains utility functions related to Android media framework, including URI debugging, user agent string creation, and file descriptor name resolution.

methods.name: uriDebugString
methods.description: Generates a debug string for a URI, optionally suppressing details for privacy or based on logging properties.

methods.name: MakeUserAgent
methods.description: Constructs a user agent string including Android version information.

methods.name: nameForFd
methods.description: Returns a string representing the filename or link target associated with a file descriptor.
